简介: You'll recognise his face from Netflix's AFTER LIFE and HBO's GAME OF THRONES. A self-styled folknographer, interested in roots music and vernacular customs, Tim Plester is the co-director of the feature documentaries WAY OF THE MORRIS, THE BALLAD OF SHIRLEY COLLINS, SOUTHERN JOURNEY (REVISITED) and the forthcoming THE ARCHIVIST. He is the creator and screenwriter of the cult comedy shorts 'ANT MUZAK', BLAKE'S JUNCTION 7 and WORLD OF WRESTLING.
